B&B Lodging In The “Capital of the Amish”
Carriage Corner B&B offers high-quality bed and breakfast accommodations in the heart of Pennsylvania Dutch Country, surrounded by beautiful farmlands. Recognized for excellent levels of service and attention to detail, you can be sure of a peaceful stay in one of Lancaster County’s premier locations.
Our aim is for you to leave Carriage Corner relaxed, refreshed and with your expectations for your stay exceeded.
Vacation in Beautiful Lancaster County
Whether you are looking for a quiet get away in Amish Country or a vacation full of shopping, sightseeing and eating, Carriage Corner offers the perfect base from which to explore all that this amazing area has to offer. Check out Things To Do in Lancaster.

Log Cabin Guest Room Lancaster, PA Carriage Corner B and B
Log Cabin Guest Room
CHECK AVAILABILITY
Amish Style Room
Log Cabin is a charming queen room furnished with Amish style furniture and it is one of our largest rooms.  The queen sized bed has a comfortable pillow top mattress, is made with silky comfortable sheets and a beautiful quilt to keep you warm.  This room also has a enchanting sitting area complete with a cozy love seat which is perfect for curling up with a good book or snuggling with someone you love.  The love seat pulls out into a twin bed with a comfortable memory foam mattress to accommodate an additional guest. Log Cabin has a large 3-piece en suite bathroom.
Log Cabin has a lovely little electric fireplace which can be used to take the chill off or just set a romantic mood.
There is also a 32 Flat Screen Roku television and free internet is available throughout Carriage Corner.

About Carriage Corner B&B
Hello, we’re Jay and Gaylen Matlock and welcome to Carriage Corner B&B.
We became the proud owners of Carriage Corner in 2016 and for the past 3 years have enjoyed welcoming guests, both new and returning, to our B&B.
We pride ourselves on helping our guests to have the best vacation possible, acting as a tour guide and advising you on the best places to visit and sharing some of the hidden gems of Lancaster county that most visitors to the area miss!
The Inn
Amenities
About
Breakfast
Dining Room
Common Area
Gift Shop

How It All Began
We both love to entertain and enjoy meeting new people.  Gaylen loves cooking and when you stay with us you will enjoy a memorable home cooked breakfast, freshly prepared using locally sourced produce.
Jay is a mechanic by trade who loves to grow both edible and pretty things in the garden.  He takes pride in the front garden being the perfect place for you to relax in the swing with a glass of wine or borrow our bocce ball set and play a spirited game.
We are East Coast transplants who enjoy travelling and love staying at bed and breakfasts ourselves. Throughout our travels, we always said we’d love to run our own B&B and here we are!
At Carriage Corner we provide a unique blend of hospitality, laughter and kindness.  Our aim is for you to leave us relaxed, refreshed and with your expectations for your stay exceeded.
If you have any questions or require any further information, we are here to help you.  Simply give us a call on 717-768-3059 or drop at email to hello@carriagecornerbandb.com.
